articles.title: Ukrainian drones target St Petersburg in attack Russia calls 'unprecedented'
articles.description: The city's governor urges residents to remain indoors for the first time since the beginning of the war.

articles.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
articles.description: The US military says it struck Iranian drones and radar sites. Tehran responds by targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

articles.title: Armenia braces for election as Russia piles pressure on pro-West government
articles.description: Incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is seeking a third term despite falling domestic support.

articles.title: Lebanon says three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
articles.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

articles.title: Putin says there is 'no point' meeting Zelensky over ending Ukraine war
articles.description: The Russian president's refusal comes after his Ukrainian counterpart wrote an open letter calling for face-to-face talks.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes cargo ships and admits Romania drone blast
articles.description: Ukraine says it struck five ships carrying illegal cargo in the Sea of Azov and in coastal waters of Russian-occupied territories.

articles.title: Man dies after shark attack in Australia
articles.description: A man has died after being attacked by a shark while fishing off Australia's southwestern coast, police say.

articles.title: Technical issue detected on one of UK's biggest warships
articles.description: A technical issue has been detected on one of the UK's largest warships as it was docked in Norway, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) said.
